TOOLS — how they work
Leader lineClick anchor, click arrowhead, type label · click it again later to recolor, resize or move (drag tip / elbow / shoulder handles)
StampTap Stamp tool → choose symbol → click to place
HighlightDrag across any area to highlight it. (Underline & strikethrough live in the Text/Note formatting bar.)
Path DistanceClick waypoints along a route; dbl-click / Enter to finish
Area / PolygonClick vertices; dbl-click or Esc to close & calculate area
Pen arc lengthShown automatically after each freehand stroke
